I had high hopes for the Cetaphil Healthy Glow Daily Cream, especially since it promises deep hydration, a healthy glow, and is marketed as suitable for sensitive skin. On paper, it sounds perfect—packed with HydroSensitiv™ Complex, Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide, Vitamin B5, and Vitamin E, all in a lightweight, non-greasy formula that's meant to soothe irritation and strengthen the skin barrier. Unfortunately, my experience was disappointing. While the cream does have a lovely smooth texture and applies beautifully, my skin reacted badly—it began to burn and turned red shortly after application. As someone with sensitive skin, this was a deal-breaker, especially since it's advertised to defend against irritation, dryness, and roughness. I will say that the cream feels pleasant going on, and I can imagine it working for someone with less reactive skin. However, for me, it simply wasn't gentle enough. Sensitive-skin users may want to patch test before committing to a full face application. I had hoped for better results, but sadly, it's not one I'll be repurchasing.

I've been using Cetaphil Facial Moisturizer for a few months now, and it has become a staple in my skincare routine. The formula is lightweight and non-greasy, making it perfect for daily use. Overall, I highly recommend Cetaphil Facial Moisturizer to anyone looking for a reliable, gentle, and effective moisturizer. It's a great value for the price, and it delivers consistent results. avis.titre: I enjoy it but it isn't anything special
avis.texte: I bought this because my skin has been so incredibly dry since I had my baby! I usually use the regular Cetaphil lotion with the green cap. I feel that this product is very similar to that. I feel like maybe it hydrates a little more. My first impression was that it felt small for the price. Such a big container for such little product. It goes on nicely though. I use it when my skin is still wet like after cleansing or after a shower. Soaks right in! I am not sure I would repurchase this product since it is so similar to the one I already had.

and no fragrance which is awesome. The jar is extremely misleading. It has false sides and bottom so there is very little product. Huge waste of plastic in a time when we should limit plastic use. Expensive for the amount of cream.

I had this sitting in my stash for quite some time and I've finally started using it. I live in NY and this is WONDERFUL for these cold frigid winter temperatures. The formula contains hyaluronic acid which helps retain water and moisture in the skin. I LOVE using this any time of the day, under makeup, at night. It's so smooth and has a lightweight whipped texture. It's so dreamy and just soaks into my skin in seconds. I fully recommend this for any type of skin. It's simple and effective
So I decided to try this because it's getting colder and my skin dries out well after 2 days of using I have a rash on my face and it burns. I'm so disappointed I really wanted to like this product
Man does this make you face feel like baby skin, it gives you a beautiful natural glow, its very light and soaks into your skin so easily.
This is one of the only moisturizers that will touch my dry irritated skin when I use a Retinol product. I do wish there was more product in the jar but overall leaves my skin hydrated and soothed.

I discovered Cetaphil Healthy Glow moisturizer a couple of years ago and I absolutely LOVE IT!!! I have incredibly dry skin, which does NOT help with the aging process. I have spent thousands of dollars (no exaggeration) on moisturizers, serums, facials, and professional treatments to help my face look a little more youthful (I haven't resorted to cosmetic surgery). I'm not trying to look twenty years younger (I'm currently in my mid-40's) I just don't want to appear OLDER than I am. Cetaphil's Healthy Glow deep hydration cream is exactly that: DEEP hydration. I use the Daily Cream, as pictured here, every night after cleansing and toning, and use the daily cream with SPF every morning to protect against damaging UVA/UVB rays. Cetaphil has done an incredibly better job than every one of the other moisturizers I've used. From drugstore, mid-range, high-end and prestige brands, even prescription creams, NONE of them have kept my skin hydrated and as healthy looking as Cetaphil Deep Hydration Healthy Glow cream. The name says it all, and it doesn't lie! I 100% recommend this product!
This is my go to daily moisturizer. I love it it makes my skin feels so nice and healthy it's great way to wake my skin up and start the day￼
Used this cream some time ago. When I use this cream it Gives a mid glow on my face and I don't need to wear makeup along. Like the final result
I love this product! Have already used 3 tubs. It's so creamy and moisturizing but absorbs into the skin quickly and doesn't leave you feeling oily. Highly recommend this product
